page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-standard-48-lssd is an arm64-based server instance powered by the ARMv8 Neoverse-V2 architecture. It features 48 dedicated physical cores with a clock speed of 3.0 GHz and a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The hardware includes 192 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core, and is bundled with 4020 GB of local NVMe SSD storage.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core capabilities and high memory throughput. The instance achieved a top-tier rating in Geekbench multi-core testing and software compilation, alongside top-tier PassMark database operations and static web serving throughput. Memory bandwidth is also strong, reaching 286.75 GB/sec for large block read-only operations. However, single-core performance is more moderate, with Geekbench single-core and stress-ng single-core scores falling into the average category.

From a resource density perspective, the instance offers high qualitative cost efficiency for multi-threaded and database workloads due to its dedicated physical cores and integrated high-capacity local NVMe storage. Tradeoffs include the absence of x86-specific instruction sets such as AVX and AMX, and average single-threaded decompression and text processing speeds. It is highly suitable for database hosting, multi-threaded software compilation, static web serving, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks.
